newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says to develop global IT unit.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says to develop global IT unit.

text.p: Swedish automotive group AB Volvo said on Thursday that it would initiate negotiations about a future global IT venture with two alternative partners, Computer Sciences Corp (CSC) and IBM.
Volvo will start negotiations with CSC and IBM next year, the company said in a statement.
Details about the cooperation and Volvo's ownership stake in the venture would be determined in negotiations with the chosen partner, Volvo said.
Volvo aims to have a deal on a new company ready after the first six months of 1997, the company said.
The company wants to find an information technology partner to set up a joint venture to provide efficient IT support for Volvo's operations worldwide, it said.
The joint venture is expected to consist of the main part of Volvo's IT operations, which include more than 2,000 employees, the company said.
Earlier this year, Volvo set up a project group to review Volvo's future IT operations, the company said.
